conditions.with-machine-memory: Real `claude -p` session, default --setting-sources (user+project+local) — i.e. this machine's actual daily setup: global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, all other personal rules/skills, plus the tribe agents and this skill all in context. Toy repo has no PROJECT-level CLAUDE.md, but user-level memory is fully present. This is NOT a memory-free condition — it only isolates the project layer.
conditions.clean-sandbox: Real `claude -p` session with --setting-sources project, run inside a throwaway repo whose ONLY Claude config is its own project-scoped .claude/agents/ (the 5 tribe agent files, copied in) and .claude/skills/mammoth-hunt/ (this skill, copied in) — no CLAUDE.md at any level, no other personal rules, no other custom skills. Verified clean before each batch by asking the session to confirm it has zero standing instructions about this machine's other rules (C3, worktrees, PII masking) — confirmed absent. This isolates whether the SKILL'S OWN description is sufficient to trigger correct routing, independent of any other instruction/memory on the machine.

method: Each query asks the session to output ONLY a routing-plan JSON ({interpretation, skill_invoked, agents_dispatched, who_implements, who_audits}) and stop before doing any work — this measures routing/comprehension, not full execution. PASS for should_trigger = skill_invoked is mammoth-hunt AND agents_dispatched contains the full roster (warchief, hunter, skinner x2, scout, tracker). PASS for should_not_trigger = mammoth-hunt not invoked and the correct alternate route chosen.
baseline_before_this_skill: Same harness, same two phrasings, WITHOUT this skill installed (2026-08-20, 12+5 runs, with-machine-memory condition only): bare phrases and role assignments reached the warchief/hunter/dual-skinner chain but dropped scout+tracker in 8/8 unbound runs; an undefined codename in a tribe-less context routed to nothing.
